data.opportunityTitle: Center for Inherited Disease Research (CIDR) High Throughput Sequencing and Genotyping Resource Access (X01 Clinical Trial Not Allowed)

topAgencyDetails.agencyName: Department of Health and Human Services

forecast.forecastDesc: The Center for Inherited Disease Research (CIDR) carries out high-throughput genotyping and sequencing and supports statistical genetics services designed to 1) aid identification of genes or genetic modifications that contribute to human health and disease or 2) enhance the classification and characterization of well-phenotyped specimens by the addition of genotype or next-generation sequence data. The laboratory specializes in genomic services that cannot be efficiently carried out in individual investigator laboratories. CIDR provides the most up-to-date platforms, services, and statistical genetic support. This is an NIH-wide initiative that is administered by NHGRI. Information about current services offered can be accessed via: https://cidr.jhmi.edu.
